title: Two children standing outside a building — The Elk school annual photo
text:
[Photo: Two children, a boy and a girl, standing outside a wooden clapboard building. The boy wears a plaid jacket and flat cap; the girl wears a plaid skirt suit and white ankle socks with dark shoes. A bare tree is visible in the background. A decorative border with repeating "EL KO" pattern surrounds the image.]

[No printed caption or text visible.]
notes: Full-page photo with decorative border reading 'EL KO' repeating pattern. No names or captions visible. Appears to be a page from The Elk school annual. Two unidentified children photographed outside a school or farm building.
